schemes.name: PM-KISAN
schemes.description: Provides ₹6,000 per year direct income support in three equal installments to eligible landholding farmer families across India to meet agricultural inputs and domestic needs.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Comprehensive yield insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks, localized calamities, post-harvest losses, and widespread crop disease outbreaks at minimal premium rates.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Provides farmers with personalized crop-wise nutrient recommendations and soil health reports to optimize fertilizer use, improve soil fertility, and reduce input costs.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Provides timely access to short-term institutional credit for cultivation expenses, post-harvest costs, and maintenance of farm assets with interest subvention benefits.

schemes.name: Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)
schemes.description: District-level agricultural science centers providing front-line demonstrations, on-farm testing of crop protection technologies, disease diagnostics, and farmer training.
